divergences.summary: Keep the accepted virtual user document, explicit Save, readonly/disposal fences and sandboxed capability clients. Exclude extension loading, workspace/remote/profile targets, AI search, arbitrary files/execution and auxiliary OS windows. Per-file rationale identifies retained symbols and non-mechanical adaptations; generic source contracts retained for dependency compatibility do not activate those products.
